items.description: A file path relative to the project root

gameUse.description: A "native" type's game that game_use can open through the plugin's gameUse hook: the operations besides open and close it supports, the input act takes, and the highest frame captureFrame may ask for

ready.description: Before a prompt is sent in a project of this type, the app runs this native command (no input), which returns { ready, message? }; when not ready, the prompt waits and the panel opens. A message of the form %key% is looked up in the plugin's locale files

changesFiles.description: false when the command never changes project files, such as a status check: it then runs during a turn and keeps no Undo

build.description: The app builds the game's web package first and gives the command its folder, as for Export web build
